self_review: Challenged every Y/N plus Tauri-host NA: release is Y from its imported owner API and release-script callers; QTS/ORT/WAV/model/fs/shell/TTS/UI rows remain N only where a matching owner API and live production caller exist. Reclassified cargo/npm QA because Vitest and renderer mock commands are neither native nor browser evidence harnesses; reclassified updates because config/plugin registration has no JS check/download/install caller; reclassified theme because its static product palette is not a runtime brand system. qts_ggml layers remain N through the active local QTS lock chain; process is NA because qts CLI is proof/test-only; Swift and unrelated capabilities are NA after target/source census.
